verdicts.rationale: All are editions/translations of Saussure's Course in General Linguistics (1916 orig; 1959 Baskin/Philosophical Library; Harris/Duckworth/Bloomsbury). Different editions, but only the survivor is indexed; all other members are indexed_state none/null, so per the editions rule they merge into the most-indexed.

Identical book (Schellenberg, The Unity of Perception, 2018, OUP). spi2018indd is an InDesign-source-file key carrying the same DOI/title/year/publisher. Both indexed but the same single work, so merge is correct.
Same DOI, title, authors (Banziger/Mortillaro/Scherer 2012), pages. scherer1986facial is a mislabeled shadow key; banziger2012introducin is a duplicate import. Same work.
Identical fields and DOI (Schlag & Schlag-Rey 2002). Schlag2001 is a Zotero-style key for the same article. Same work.

All share DOI/title 'Iconic variables' (Schlenker et al.). schlenker2012iconic is an indexed preprint (2012) of the 2013 published deepIndexed survivor; the rest are shadow/duplicate keys. Preprint-vs-published plus duplicates all merge.

Despite the 'i'/'ii' citekey suffixes, both records carry identical bib data: same title 'Super monsters I', same DOI 10.3765/sp.10.9. The genuine Super Monsters II has a different DOI (sp.11.5); this 'ii' key is a duplicate of Part I, not the companion paper. Neither is independently indexed. Same work.

All share DOI/title 'Gesture projection and cosuppositions' (Schlenker 2018). Schlenker2018a is a Zotero key; schlenker2018projecti is an empty-fields shadow under the same DOI cluster; schlenker2018gesturea is a duplicate. Same work.

All share DOI 10.1111/phpe.12122, title 'What is Super Semantics?', vol 32/1, pp 365-453 (Schlenker 2018, Philosophical Perspectives). Only the survivor is indexed; the rest are Zotero/year-variant/misc duplicate keys. Same work.

All carry DOI/title 'Iconological Semantics' (Schlenker & Lamberton 2024, L&P 47/5). The sep-sign-language-semantics key is misleading but its bib fields match the survivor exactly (incollection recast of the same article). Schlenker2024 is a Zotero key. Same work.
Same title 'Super pragmatics of (linguistic-)pictorial discourse', authors (Schloder & Altshuler 2023), vol 46, pp 693-746, DOI matches. schloderaltshuler2023super is a hand-key duplicate. Same work.
Identical DOI, title, author, year, vol 11/1, pp 303-330 (Schloss 2025). Schloss2025 is a Zotero-style key. Same work.
Same DOI, title 'Object Persistence in Philosophy and Psychology' (Scholl 2007, Mind & Language 22/5, 563-591). Scholl2007 is a Zotero-style key. Same work.
